offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment, irrigation systems, snow throwers and underground construction equipment. Sells mainly to professional landscapers, golf courses, contractors and homeowners, through dealers, home centers and direct accounts.

primary_products.value: commercial mowers; residential lawn mowers; snow blowers; irrigation systems; underground construction equipment

customer_segment.value: B2B: professional landscapers, golf and sports turf managers, contractors, rental companies; B2C: homeowners buying lawn mowers, snow blowers and irrigation; B2G: municipalities and government grounds maintenance crews

end_markets.value: landscaping; golf and sports turf; residential lawn care; construction and utilities; agriculture

revenue_model.value: product sales: equipment sold to professional and residential customers; other: replacement parts, attachments and accessories

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds equipment from purchased components, sold to dealers and distributors; brand owner: sells equipment under its own brands through dealers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Australia, and other countries worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: turf equipment, irrigation systems, snow throwers and Ditch Witch underground construction equipment

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent professional and residential equipment dealers; third-party retail: home improvement and big-box retail chains; direct sales: national accounts with golf courses and large landscape contractors; online: online sales of parts, accessories and some products
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: engine emissions and product safety rules from EPA and CPSC, plus product liability
